REQ-01.req_text: Full-time staff get 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
REQ-01.title: Yearly leave allowance of 20 days
REQ-01.goal: to get 20 days of paid annual leave each calendar year
REQ-01.benefit: I know how much time off I can plan

criteria.given: a full-time staff member at the start of the leave year
criteria.then: the app shows an allowance of 20 days

criteria.given: a full-time staff member has already booked all 20 days this year
criteria.when: they request one more day of annual leave
criteria.then: the app blocks the request and explains that the allowance is used up

REQ-02.req_text: Staff can carry over at most 5 unused annual leave days into the next year.
REQ-02.title: Carry over up to 5 unused days
REQ-02.goal: to carry over up to 5 unused leave days into next year
REQ-02.benefit: I don't lose leave I couldn't take

criteria.given: a staff member has unused annual leave at the end of the leave year
criteria.then: up to 5 unused days are carried over

criteria.given: a staff member has more than 5 unused days at the end of the leave year
criteria.then: only 5 days are carried over and the rest are shown as lost

REQ-03.req_text: Staff can see their current leave balance in the app at any time.
REQ-03.title: See my leave balance
REQ-03.goal: to see my current leave balance in the app at any time
REQ-03.benefit: I can plan time off without asking HR

criteria.then: their remaining leave balance is shown in days

criteria.given: a staff member's leave request has just been approved
criteria.when: they return to the home screen
criteria.then: the balance shows the new number of remaining days

REQ-04.req_text: Staff can carry over up to 10 unused leave days into the next year.
REQ-04.title: Carry over up to 10 unused days
REQ-04.goal: to carry over up to 10 unused leave days into next year
REQ-04.benefit: I don't lose leave I couldn't take during busy periods

criteria.given: a staff member has unused annual leave at the end of the leave year
criteria.then: up to 10 unused days are carried over

criteria.given: a staff member has more than 10 unused days at the end of the leave year
criteria.then: only 10 days are carried over and the rest are shown as lost
